Description: A 4.5-cycle, 266-amp, single-line-to-ground fault tripped a single-phase line recloser, which stayed open 1.4 seconds and auto-reclosed. The fault resumed immediately as an 18-cycle, 247- amp, single-line-to-ground fault that tripped the line recloser again (or blew a fuse). There was no further auto-reclosing. Both faults were on phase A
